Knee.title: KOOS, JR — Knee / الركبة
Knee.description: Knee injury and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score – Joint Replacement (KOOS-JR). 7 items (Saudi-Arabic version). Raw 0–28 converted via official Rasch table to 0–100 (100 = no disability, 0 = worst).

questions.text: مستوى الألم الآن (0-10)  /  Current Pain Level (0–10)
questions.description: 0 = لا يوجد ألم (No pain) ← → 10 = أشد ألم يتخيله العقل (Worst imaginable)

questions.text:
S6. كيف تكون شدة التصلب في ركبتك بعد الاستيقاظ صباحاً؟
(How severe is your knee stiffness after first waking in the morning?)

P2. الإلتواء / اللف على ركبتك
(Twisting / pivoting on your knee)

P3. مد الركبة بالكامل
(Straightening your knee fully)

P6. صعود أو نزول الدرج
(Going up or down stairs)

P9. الوقوف باستقامة
(Standing upright)

A3. القيام من وضع الجلوس
(Rising from sitting)

A5. الإنحناء لإلتقاط شيء من الأرض
(Bending to floor / pick up an object)

Hip.title: HOOS Full — Hip / الورك
Hip.description: Hip disability and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score – Full version (HOOS). 40 items across 6 subscales (Symptoms, Stiffness, Pain, Daily Living, Sport, QoL). Each item scored 0–4 (0=Extreme, 4=None). Final score: (rawSum / 160) × 100 → 0–100 (100 = no disability).

questions.text: مستوى الألم الآن (0-10)  /  Current Pain Level (0–10)
questions.description: 0 = لا يوجد ألم (No pain) ← → 10 = أشد ألم يتخيله العقل (Worst imaginable)

questions.text: S1. Do you feel grinding, hear clicking or any other type of noise from your hip?
S2. Difficulties spreading legs wide apart
S3. Difficulties to stride out when walking
S4. How severe is your hip joint stiffness after first wakening in the morning?
S5. How severe is your hip stiffness after sitting, lying or resting later in the day?
P1. How often is your hip painful?
P2. What amount of pain have you experienced — Straightening your hip fully?
P3. Bending your hip fully
P4. Walking on a flat surface
P5. Going up or down stairs
P6. At night while in bed
P7. Sitting or lying
P8. Standing upright
P9. Walking on a hard surface (asphalt, concrete, etc.)
P10. Walking on an uneven surface
A1. Descending stairs
A2. Ascending stairs
A3. Rising from sitting
A4. Standing
A5. Bending to floor / pick up an object
A6. Walking on flat surface
A7. Getting in / out of car
A8. Going shopping
A9. Putting on socks / stockings
A10. Rising from bed
A11. Taking off socks / stockings
A12. Lying in bed (turning over, maintaining hip position)
A13. Getting in / out of bath
A14. Sitting
A15. Getting on / off toilet
A16. Heavy domestic duties (moving heavy boxes, scrubbing floors, etc.)
A17. Light domestic duties (cooking, dusting, etc.)
SP1. Squatting
SP2. Running
SP3. Twisting / pivoting on your injured hip
SP4. Walking on uneven surface
Q1. How often are you aware of your hip problem?
Q2. Have you modified your life style to avoid potentially damaging activities to your hip?
Q3. How much are you troubled with lack of confidence in your hip?
Q4. In general, how much difficulty do you have with your hip?

Shoulder.title: QuickDASH — Shoulder / الكتف
Shoulder.description: QuickDASH — 11-item short form of Disabilities of the Arm, Shoulder and Hand (Arabic). Each item scored 1–5 (1=No difficulty/None, 5=Unable/Extreme). Formula: ((sum/n) − 1) × 25 → 0–100 (0=no disability, 100=maximum disability). Minimum 10 of 11 items required.

questions.text: مستوى الألم الآن (0-10)  /  Current Pain Level (0–10)
questions.description: 0 = لا يوجد ألم (No pain) ← → 10 = أشد ألم يتخيله العقل (Worst imaginable)

questions.text:
1. فتح مرطبان أو غطاء محكم الإغلاق
   (Open a tight or new jar)

2. القيام بأعمال منزلية تتطلب مجهودًا بالذراع
   (Do heavy household chores)

3. حمل كيس مشتريات أو حقيبة
   (Carry a shopping bag or briefcase)

4. غسل أو الوصول إلى منطقة الظهر
   (Wash your back)

5. استخدام السكين لتقطيع الطعام
   (Use a knife to cut food)

6. القيام بنشاط ترفيهي يتطلب قوة أو ضغطًا على الذراع/الكتف/اليد
   (Recreational activities with force/impact through arm, shoulder or hand)

sections.title: التأثير الاجتماعي والوظيفي / Social & Work Impact (Items 7–8)

questions.text:
7. إلى أي درجة أثرت المشكلة على نشاطاتك الاجتماعية؟
   (During the past week, to what extent has your problem interfered with your normal social activities?)
options: أبداً لا / لا على الإطلاق (Not at all)

questions.text:
8. إلى أي درجة حدّت المشكلة من عملك أو نشاطاتك اليومية المعتادة؟
   (During the past week, were you limited in your work or other regular daily activities?)
options: غير محدود على الإطلاق (Not limited at all)

questions.text:
9. ما شدة الألم في الذراع أو الكتف أو اليد؟
   (Arm, shoulder or hand pain)

10. ما شدة التنميل أو الوخز؟
   (Tingling — pins and needles — in arm, shoulder or hand)

11. إلى أي درجة أثرت المشكلة على نومك؟
   (How much difficulty did you have sleeping because of the pain?)
options: بحيث لا أقدر على النوم (So much I can't sleep)

Low Back.title: ODI — Low Back / أسفل الظهر
Low Back.description: Oswestry Disability Index v2.1a. 10 sections scored 0–5 each. Formula: (rawSum / (answered×5)) × 100 → 0–100% (0=no disability, 100=maximum disability).

questions.text: مستوى الألم الآن (0-10)  /  Current Pain Level (0–10)
questions.description: 0 = لا يوجد ألم (No pain) ← → 10 = أشد ألم يتخيله العقل (Worst imaginable)

questions.text: How would you rate your current back pain?
options: I have no pain at the moment  /  لا يوجد ألم
The pain is very mild  /  ألم خفيف جداً
The pain is moderate  /  ألم متوسط
The pain is fairly severe  /  ألم شديد نسبياً
The pain is very severe  /  ألم شديد جداً
The pain is the worst imaginable  /  أشد ألم يمكن تخيله

questions.text: How does your back pain affect your ability to look after yourself?
options: I can look after myself normally without pain
I can look after myself normally but it is painful
It is painful and I am slow and careful
I need some help but manage most personal care
I need help every day in most aspects of self care
I do not get dressed; I wash with difficulty and stay in bed

questions.text: How does your back pain affect your ability to lift things?
options: I can lift heavy weights without extra pain
I can lift heavy weights but it gives extra pain
Pain prevents me lifting heavy weights off the floor, but I can if conveniently placed
Pain prevents me lifting heavy weights, but I manage light to medium if conveniently placed
I can lift only very light weights
I cannot lift or carry anything at all

questions.text: How does your back pain affect your ability to walk?
options: Pain does not prevent me walking any distance
Pain prevents me walking more than 1 mile (1.6 km)
Pain prevents me walking more than 0.5 mile (800 m)
Pain prevents me walking more than 100 yards (90 m)
I can only walk using a stick or crutches
I am in bed most of the time and have to crawl to the toilet

questions.text: How does your back pain affect your ability to sit?
options: I can sit in any chair as long as I like
I can only sit in my favourite chair as long as I like
Pain prevents me sitting more than 1 hour
Pain prevents me sitting more than 30 minutes
Pain prevents me sitting more than 10 minutes
Pain prevents me sitting at all

questions.text: How does your back pain affect your ability to stand?
options: I can stand as long as I want without extra pain
I can stand as long as I want but it gives extra pain
Pain prevents me standing more than 1 hour
Pain prevents me standing more than 30 minutes
Pain prevents me standing more than 10 minutes
Pain prevents me standing at all

questions.text: How does your back pain affect your sleep?
options: My sleep is never disturbed by pain
My sleep is occasionally disturbed by pain
Because of pain I have less than 6 hours sleep
Because of pain I have less than 4 hours sleep
Because of pain I have less than 2 hours sleep
Pain prevents me from sleeping at all

questions.text: How does your back pain affect your sex life (if applicable)?
options: My sex life is normal and causes no extra pain
My sex life is normal but causes some extra pain
My sex life is nearly normal but is very painful
My sex life is severely restricted by pain
My sex life is nearly absent because of pain
Pain prevents any sex life at all

questions.text: How does your back pain affect your social life?
options: My social life is normal and causes no extra pain
My social life is normal but increases the degree of pain
Pain has no significant effect on my social life apart from limiting energetic interests (e.g. sport)
Pain has restricted my social life and I do not go out as often
Pain has restricted my social life to my home
I have no social life because of pain

questions.text: How does your back pain affect your ability to travel?
options: I can travel anywhere without extra pain
I can travel anywhere but it gives extra pain
Pain is bad but I manage journeys over 2 hours
Pain restricts me to journeys of less than 1 hour
Pain restricts me to short necessary journeys under 30 minutes
Pain prevents me from traveling except to receive treatment

Neck & Cervical.title: NDI — Neck & Cervical / الرقبة والعنق
Neck & Cervical.description: Neck Disability Index. 10 sections scored 0–5 each. Formula: (rawSum / (answered×5)) × 100 → 0–100% (0=no disability, 100=maximum disability).

questions.text: مستوى الألم الآن (0-10)  /  Current Pain Level (0–10)
questions.description: 0 = لا يوجد ألم (No pain) ← → 10 = أشد ألم يتخيله العقل (Worst imaginable)

questions.text: How would you rate your current neck pain?
options: I have no pain at the moment
The pain is very mild at the moment
The pain is moderate at the moment
The pain is fairly severe at the moment
The pain is very severe at the moment
The pain is the worst imaginable at the moment

questions.text: How does your neck pain affect your ability to look after yourself?
options: I can look after myself normally without extra pain
I can look after myself normally but it causes extra pain
It is painful to look after myself and I am slow and careful
I need some help but manage most of my personal care
I need help every day in most aspects of self care
I do not get dressed, wash with difficulty and stay in bed

questions.text: How does your neck pain affect your ability to lift things?
options: I can lift heavy weights without extra pain
I can lift heavy weights but it gives extra pain
Pain prevents me lifting heavy weights off the floor, but I can if conveniently placed
Pain prevents me lifting heavy weights, but I can manage light to medium if conveniently placed
I can lift only very light weights
I cannot lift or carry anything at all

questions.text: How does your neck pain affect your ability to read?
options: I can read as much as I want with no neck pain
I can read as much as I want with slight neck pain
I can read as much as I want with moderate neck pain
I cannot read as much as I want because of moderate neck pain
I cannot read as much as I want because of severe neck pain

questions.text: How does your neck pain relate to headaches?
options: I have no headaches at all
I have slight headaches which come infrequently
I have moderate headaches which come infrequently
I have moderate headaches which come frequently
I have severe headaches which come frequently
I have headaches almost all the time

questions.text: How does your neck pain affect your ability to concentrate?
options: I can concentrate fully when I want with no difficulty
I can concentrate fully with slight difficulty
I have a fair degree of difficulty concentrating
I have a lot of difficulty concentrating
I have a great deal of difficulty concentrating

questions.text: How does your neck pain affect your work?
options: I can do as much work as I want
I can only do my usual work, but no more
I can do most of my usual work, but no more
I cannot do my usual work
I can hardly do any work at all
I cannot do any work at all

questions.text: How does your neck pain affect driving?
options: I can drive my car without any neck pain
I can drive my car as long as I want with slight neck pain
I can drive my car as long as I want with moderate neck pain
I cannot drive my car as long as I want because of moderate neck pain
I can hardly drive at all because of severe neck pain
I cannot drive my car at all

questions.text: How does your neck pain affect your sleep?
options: My sleep is slightly disturbed (less than 1 hour sleepless)
My sleep is mildly disturbed (1–2 hours sleepless)
My sleep is moderately disturbed (2–3 hours sleepless)
My sleep is greatly disturbed (3–5 hours sleepless)
My sleep is completely disturbed (5+ hours sleepless)

questions.text: How does your neck pain affect your recreation activities?
options: I am able to engage in all my recreation activities with no neck pain
I am able to engage in all my recreation activities with some neck pain
I am able to engage in most, but not all, of my usual recreation activities
I am able to engage in only a few of my usual recreation activities
I can hardly do any recreation activities because of neck pain
I cannot do any recreation activities at all

Foot & Ankle.title: SEFAS — Foot & Ankle / القدم والكاحل
Foot & Ankle.description: Self-Reported Foot and Ankle Score (SEFAS). 12 items scored 0–4 (4=No difficulty, 0=Unable). Formula: (rawSum / 48) × 100 → 0–100 (0=worst, 100=best).

questions.text: مستوى الألم الآن (0-10)  /  Current Pain Level (0–10)
questions.description: 0 = لا يوجد ألم (No pain) ← → 10 = أشد ألم يتخيله العقل (Worst imaginable)

questions.text:
1. الألم في قدمك / كاحلك أثناء الراحة
   (Pain in your foot/ankle at rest)

2. الألم في قدمك / كاحلك أثناء المشي على سطح مستوٍ
   (Pain when walking on a flat surface)

3. الألم في قدمك / كاحلك أثناء الليل
   (Pain in your foot/ankle at night)

4. مسافة المشي محدودة بسبب قدمك / كاحلك
   (Walking distance is limited by your foot/ankle)

5. المشي على أرض غير مستوية
   (Walking on uneven ground)

6. صعود أو نزول الدرج
   (Walking up or down stairs)

7. الوقوف لفترة طويلة
   (Standing for a long period)

8. إيجاد أحذية مريحة
   (Finding footwear that is comfortable)

9. العمل أو الأنشطة اليومية محدودة بسبب قدمك / كاحلك
   (Work or daily activities limited by foot/ankle)

10. الأنشطة الرياضية أو الترفيهية محدودة بسبب قدمك / كاحلك
   (Leisure or sporting activities limited by foot/ankle)

11. الثقة والتوازن أثناء المشي
   (Confidence / stability when walking)

12. بشكل عام، كم أثرت مشكلة قدمك / كاحلك على حياتك اليومية هذا الأسبوع؟
   (Overall, how much has your foot/ankle problem interfered with daily life this week?)
